messages.subject: Saturday five-a-side
messages.plaintextBody:
Mate — are you still good for five-a-side Saturday 10am at Shoreditch Powerleague? Need to know numbers by Friday or we forfeit the pitch. Reply all if you can chase the others.

Marcus
